The read: Second read. The permission ("the number of character positions reserved on the medium to store a particular logical record may be different from the number of character positions in the description of that record in the program") separates physical reservation from the logical record. Its program-visible content is that the reservation never shows through: a relative file with RECORD CONTAINS 5 TO 20 CHARACTERS stores a 5- and a 20-character record and reads each back unchanged. That accepted program witnesses the only behaviour the permission leaves the user, so the row is testable rather than unsettleable.
